settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 3–7 business days across India. Shipping is free on orders over ₹2,999.

Unworn pieces with tags attached can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.

settings.question: How do I choose the right size?
settings.answer: Our pieces follow standard age sizing. If your child is between sizes, we recommend sizing up — most styles have room to grow.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 3–7 business days across India.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange an item?
settings.answer: Yes. Unworn pieces with tags attached can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery.

settings.question: How should I care for the garments?
settings.answer: Most of our cottons are machine-washable on a gentle cold cycle. Embellished and silk pieces should be dry cleaned. Always check the care label.
